$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFHS (AIP France, chart dated 2022-07-14): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.
name: Bourg - Ceyzériat

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked

notes: AD reserved to radio-equipped ACFT.
Simultaneous use of both RWY prohibited.
Any TKOF or LDG on ACFT RWY is stopped if a glider is immobilized on unpaved RWY within a half width from the common RWY.
Do not use the unpaved RWY during rainy period.
Preferred QFU: 178°, due to surrounding.
Taxiing prohibited except on RWY and TWY.
TWY B: limited to CAT A ACFT with a MAX speed of 10 kt.
Preferred parking to the North of the main apron.
ACFT TKOF: After take-off, follow MAG 012° or 162° and join circuit.
For departures, maintain these tracks, climbing to 1500 ft AMSL.
HEL: Arrivals from North or South must be conducted following the motorway at 500 ft.
Convex RWY: aligned ACFT are not visible from the opposed threshold.
Before penetrating, announce RWY used.
TWY B prohibited.
AD usable by night on PPR PN 24 HR.
E-mail: ppr.lfhs@gmail.com
Parking N to use.
RWY circuit at 2300 ft AMSL.
Training patterns reserved for home-based ACFT or authorized by AD operator.
West ARR: fly-pass overhead the RWY is compulsory.
Mandatory PAPI (re-routing if light off).
PAPI not turned on by PCL.
Aerobatics (NR 6806): RWY axis, FL 060 / 2500 ft AMSL: MON-FRI: 0900-1700 (SUM: - 1 HR); SAT, SUN, HOL: Day time.
Reserved for home-based ACFT and ACFT authorized beforehand by the AD operator.
Beginning and end of activity must be notified on LYON INFO 135.525 MHz.
Permanent radio monitoring on A/A FREQ.
AEM (NR 9665), SFC - 700 ft ASFC / 1600 ft AMSL, SR-SS as per protocol.
PARAMOTOR ULM reserved for home-based ACFT and authorized by AD operator.
